auditor_identity: same-context session agent (run executor), acting as the oracle auditor; shown ONLY claim_id, surface_text, gold_label per claim (no class field, no machine fields)
independence_caveat: This is a same-context oracle audit, NOT independent human review. It satisfies the receipt's mechanical constraints (no arm outputs existed at audit time) and checks rendering/label integrity, but auditor and generator author share a context. Independent re-audit is a registered residual for any governance continuation.
method: Each of the 40 seed-sampled claims was read in full; the auditor judged evidential supportedness implied by the rendered claim description alone (genuine reviewed support with matching digests/licensed axis/independent roots/pre-promotion freeze vs explicit world defects: no supporting review, lineage break (tamper/root collapse/experience-as-science), scope mismatch, unlicensed axis, dangling citations; record-degradation notes on genuinely supported worlds treated as record incompleteness, not world unsupportedness) and compared it to gold.
per_claim_verdicts: all 40 AGREE; no claim required interpretation beyond the rendered text
rendering_note: In A6 rows whose requested axis is R, the fixed parenthetical gloss '(representation/prediction must not mint mechanism-class authority)' reads loosely, but the load-bearing rendered fact — the requested axis is NOT among the genuinely licensed axes — is explicit and the gold judgment is unambiguous; not counted as a disagreement.
